title: PLP - Filter & Sorting
description:
## MVP Filter & Sorting

Google Retail Connect is required to get started with Ambiendo, but the solution must also work without it.

---

## Standard Filter Bar

Is based on Shopify Standard. has the option to work with Google Retail Connect App, which is needed for Ambiendo MVP.

[https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14980-153735&t=JdNx9y5r0PDJX6eC-4](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14980-153735&t=JdNx9y5r0PDJX6eC-4)

---

<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> **User Story**

**As a** user browsing the product listing page,  
**I want** to see how many products match my current filters and have quick access to sorting and filtering options,  
**So that** I can efficiently narrow down and organize the results to find what I'm looking for.

### Requirements

| **Figma properties:** breakpoint active filters yes/no more then 4 filters yes/no google retail connect yes/no Watch [**Ambiendo mobile dummy**](https://www.figma.com/proto/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=1-47&p=f&viewport=-5079%2C384%2C0.25&t=JdNx9y5r0PDJX6eC-0&scaling=scale-down&content-scaling=fixed&starting-point-node-id=14894%3A105958&show-proto-sidebar=1) to see interaction: _Clicked filters from the GRC App combined with filters in the off canvas sheet._ Watch[ Basic Filter Dummy ](https://www.figma.com/proto/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=1-47&p=f&viewport=-10451%2C-1014%2C0.5&t=JdNx9y5r0PDJX6eC-0&scaling=scale-down&content-scaling=fixed&starting-point-node-id=14980%3A109869&show-proto-sidebar=1)and filter for the color

| ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=d5da6ebf-e624-4f33-a9ab-d853d474cf52&&collection=&height=84&occurrenceKey=null&width=415&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=98d58c71-69ff-4876-8c3e-78a8da0111a1&&collection=&height=230&occurrenceKey=null&width=413&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) |

| **Active / set filters:** Clicking the primary button
opens the filter off canvas sheet Clicking the ghost button

opens the sorting off canvas sheet If any filter is selected, display a tertiarry button small with a delete icon and the corresponding filter name Tapping/clicking on the filter button deletes the selection If there are more then 4 filters slected, display an additional ghost button small

if this button is clicked → all active filters are removed | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=57e9a791-1986-469a-b046-7e6dd4ed925f&&collection=&height=385&occurrenceKey=null&width=377&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=e1750be8-0fce-4f2f-b002-b7a905e58763&&collection=&height=645&occurrenceKey=null&width=420&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)  |
| **Sticky behaviour** See example [here](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14980-153702&t=JdNx9y5r0PDJX6eC-4) And see example for [mobile and desktop here from ikea.](https://www.ikea.com/de/de/cat/kissen--bezuege-10659/)  The normal sticky shop header is displayed (if it isn't turned of) When the filter bar scrolls out of the viewport, the sticky filter bar is displayed and

| **Product Count Display** Shows total number of products currently visible after applying filters. Dynamically updates as filters are applied or cleared. | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=ad117719-a152-446a-877c-6e1c4bbdf3e2&&collection=&height=34&occurrenceKey=null&width=135&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)  |
| **Accessibility Requirements:** **Keyboard Navigation:** All interactive elements (buttons, dropdowns) must be reachable and operable via keyboard (Tab, Enter, Arrow keys). **ARIA Roles & Attributes:** Use appropriate ARIA roles: `aria-haspopup="dialog"` or `menu` for buttons that open modals or dropdowns. Include `aria-expanded` to reflect open/closed state of filters or sort menus. Ensure live updates (like product count) use `aria-live="polite"` to announce changes for screen readers. **Focus Management:** When a modal or menu is opened, focus should shift to the first focusable element inside. Focus should return to the trigger element (e.g., "All Filters" button) when the modal/menu is closed. **Screen Reader Support:** Buttons should have clear, descriptive labels (e.g., `aria-label="Open all filters"`). Product count should be announced clearly (e.g., "Showing 45 products"). |  |

## Filter Off Canvas

<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-1">:person_with_crown:</custom> **User Story**

**As a** user shopping online,  
**I want** to open a filter panel that slides in from the side of the screen,  
**So that** I can easily refine product results without leaving the product listing page.

---

### Requirements

[https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=15139-115934&t=reqgsA9rbH2D4nWh-4](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=15139-115934&t=reqgsA9rbH2D4nWh-4) 

Please note the annotations in Figma, because they have direct information about the design and behavior

| **Triggering the Sheet** Opens when the user clicks the **"All Filters"** button. Closes when the user clicks the **close button**, clicks outside the panel, or presses **Esc**. |  |
| --- | --- |
| **Apply & Clear Actions** **Apply button** applies selected filters and closes the sheet. **Clear all** link/button resets all filters in the panel. **Dynamic Feedback** Shows the number of products matching the current filter selection before applying. | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=45e49bd2-4f7a-4a51-9c06-2863a4253ced&&collection=&height=123&occurrenceKey=null&width=367&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)  |
| **Color filters** are displayed in a grid as [color tiles](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=15055-191628&t=JdNx9y5r0PDJX6eC-4) default sorting: descending from the highest number of products have states default, hover, pressed, focus selected yes/no each tile has a color chip, a color name and the amount of products with this color | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=b100b750-cd2c-42d6-abb0-327889226349&&collection=&height=331&occurrenceKey=null&width=292&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=de20a292-4ad4-456c-b155-665e31867160&&collection=&height=623&occurrenceKey=null&width=347&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)  |
| [Off Canvas Components](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=15117-193163&t=JdNx9y5r0PDJX6eC-4) [filter-accordion-item](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=15055-191971&t=JdNx9y5r0PDJX6eC-4) is similar to internal accordion item but different paddings and styling icon on the left is optional has active filters true/false is open true/false has states default, hover, pressed focus [filter-switch-item](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=15055-193139&t=JdNx9y5r0PDJX6eC-4) same layout as accrodion closed item, but not to open. Has a [switch](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=3613-64801&t=JdNx9y5r0PDJX6eC-4) button instead [Checkbox list item](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=15117-194382&t=JdNx9y5r0PDJX6eC-4) contains [amount pill](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=15117-194362&t=JdNx9y5r0PDJX6eC-4) (themed) | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=70486101-a337-4594-bce9-f2e892da7763&&collection=&height=344&occurrenceKey=null&width=758&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=0f21722b-5c5e-4667-9e75-bc3cadd450f4&&collection=&height=71&occurrenceKey=null&width=358&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=147146e8-e23b-49ee-bbca-e87069830e1b&&collection=&height=47&occurrenceKey=null&width=344&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)  |

## Sorting Dropdown

If the user clicks on the "Sort" button, a dropdown menu opens with which he can influence the sorting of the products on the list.

Uses [**dropdown menu**](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=606-17197&t=reqgsA9rbH2D4nWh-4) **with indicator** 

* the indicator marks the active sorting option
* only one option can be selected

Please look at component props in figma.

enrichedData.purpose: Enables users to efficiently narrow down and organize product results on the product listing page through filtering and sorting options, with dynamic product count updates and accessible interactions.
useCases: Display product count that dynamically updates as filters are applied or cleared
Open filter off-canvas sheet via 'All filters' button
Show active filters as removable tags with delete icons
Provide 'Reset all filters' option when more than 4 filters are selected
Implement sticky filter bar that replaces header when scrolled past
Display color filters as visual tiles with color chip, name, and product count
Use accordion items for collapsible filter groups
Use switch items for boolean filter toggles
Use checkbox list items with amount pills for multi-select filters
Show matching product count before applying filters in off-canvas sheet
Support keyboard navigation with proper focus management
Integrate with Google Retail Connect for enhanced filtering capabilities
